title: Over My Dead Body
author: Audible Original
description: A Hollywood stuntwoman turned personal injury attorney. A handsome disbarred lawyer with a dark past. And an elaborate scheme that leads to murder. Former Hollywood stuntwoman Vanessa Motta has traded fake car crashes for real ones. As an up-and-coming personal injury attorney in New Orleans, she’s found the perfect partner in her new boyfriend and mentor, Sean Alfortish. So what if he’s a disbarred lawyer with a shady past? With Sean’s help, the cases start rolling in – and the big settlements. But there’s just one problem: the accidents are as staged as a Hollywood car crash. And once the secret gets out, someone will have to pay. From Audible comes the fifth season of _Over My Dead Body: Operation Sideswipe_, a six-part series about greed, betrayal, and who gets thrown under the bus when everything is on the line. Reported and hosted by Mitch Moxley.
